body.statement: Outlook question. Fix finite \((\mathcal E,T)\), \(\alpha_{\rm conf}\in(0,1)\), and \(\bar\rho>0\). Does the boundary-spliced active-face multiplier handle yield rectangles \(\mathcal C^G_n\) such that, over \(\mathfrak A_T(\bar\rho)\) with no lower bound on cell probabilities, active-face gaps, or affine-face variances, \[\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{(P_k)\in\mathfrak A_T(\bar\rho)}\Pr_{P_n}\{(L_T(p_n),U_T(p_n))\in\mathcal C^G_n\}\geq1-\alpha_{\rm conf}.\] In addition, for every nonempty compact regular class \(\mathcal K(\varepsilon_{\rm reg},\gamma_{\rm reg},\sigma^2_{\rm reg})\), can the same rectangles satisfy \[\limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{P\in\mathcal K}\frac{\mathbb E_P[w_{\rm tot}(\mathcal C^G_n)]}{\mathbb E_P[w_{\rm tot}(\mathcal C_{\rm end})]}<1,\] where total endpoint width is \(w_{\rm tot}([l_{\rm lo},l_{\rm hi}]\times[u_{\rm lo},u_{\rm hi}])=(l_{\rm hi}-l_{\rm lo})+(u_{\rm hi}-u_{\rm lo})\)?
body.justification: This short Outlook isolates the genuinely open statistical rung with separate global validity and regular-class precision requirements.
body.gap: Directional-differentiability and intersection-bound methods handle ties on regular classes, but their combination does not automatically cover simultaneously vanishing multinomial variances and boundary cells.
body.consumer: A positive answer would replace the conservative production band by a shorter default while preserving a certified fallback for sparse adherence tables.

obligation.what_is_open: An explicit calibration and proof for one multiplier rectangle that is uniformly valid across simultaneous local face ties and vanishing face variances, while also strictly improving expected total width on every compact regular class.
obligation.obstruction: The frozen handle does not specify the near-active threshold, the variance-degeneracy threshold, or the multiplier critical-value rule. A regular finite-dimensional Gaussian approximation does not control triangular arrays at the transition where variances vanish and the data-dependent splice can select the Gaussian branch with nonnegligible probability.
obligation.attempted: Conditioning on the finite face vector, self-normalized near-active selection, and a variance-threshold fallback reduce the issue to uniform control of selection error and Gaussian anti-concentration near the threshold. The stated primitives supply neither that transition theorem nor enough calibration detail to derive it without assuming the crux.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved finite-sample fallback satisfies, for every sample size \(n\) and every compatible \(P\),
\[
 \Pr_P\!\left\{(L_T(p),U_T(p))\in\mathcal C_{\rm end},\ [L_T(p),U_T(p)]\subseteq\mathcal C_{\rm set}\right\}\ge1-\alpha_{\rm conf},
\]
including local or exact face ties, zero cells, vanishing face variances, and empty instrument arms under the stipulated trivial output.  This establishes the unrestricted validity rung, but it does not establish the strict regular-class expected-width ratio for the proposed Gaussian rectangle.
